# Scholarly review templates

These templates support the scholarly-integrity interstitial and future diff-based historical review.

They are conceptual/review aids until the interstitial establishes canonical machine-readable schemas. Do not treat Markdown completeness as evidence quality.

- `HISTORICAL_RESOLUTION_DOSSIER_TEMPLATE.md` — Class D occurrence/entity comparison, positive and contradictory evidence, source dependency, adjudication, and reversibility.
- `HISTORICAL_REVIEW_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md` — packet/batch delta summary, sampling, audits, exception queue, external-review candidates, and publication recommendation.
- `HISTORICAL_AUDITOR_HANDOFF.md` — model-agnostic prompts for source-fidelity, entity-resolution, interpretive-prose, reconstruction, and adjudication review.

Canonical policy remains in:

- `../SCHOLARLY_INTEGRITY.md`
- `../HISTORICAL_ASSERTION_POLICY.md`
- `../HISTORICAL_REVIEW_POLICY.md`
- `../ENTITY_RESOLUTION_POLICY.md`
- `../SECONDARY_SCHOLARSHIP_POLICY.md`
- `../CORRECTIONS_POLICY.md`
- `../SCHOLARLY_REVIEW_INTERSTITIAL.md`

The local maintainer setup/checklist is `../LOCAL_GEMINI_SCHOLARLY_REVIEW_SETUP.md`.
